categories.main_business_segments: eBay operates a single reportable business segment focused on its global online marketplace platforms, which include eBay.com, localized counterparts, off-platform marketplaces, and a suite of mobile apps. The company enables millions of buyers and sellers to transact in a wide range of product categories, with particular emphasis on parts & accessories, collectibles, fashion, electronics, and home & garden.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: eBay's platforms are built on proprietary technologies that support intuitive user interfaces, robust transaction processing, and scalable infrastructure. The company leverages artificial intelligence (AI), including generative AI, to enhance listing creation, search, personalization, and advertising. eBay has modernized its infrastructure for reliability and scalability, and continues to invest in AI-driven seller tools, authentication services, and payment systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: eBay primarily serves individual consumers and small to medium-sized businesses as both buyers and sellers. Its key end markets include enthusiasts and value-seeking consumers in categories such as auto parts, collectibles, refurbished goods, luxury items, and general consumer goods. The platform is designed to appeal to a diverse, global community seeking unique selection and value.
categories.geographic_coverage: eBay operates in more than 190 markets worldwide, with approximately half of its gross merchandise volume (GMV) and net revenues generated outside the United States. Major international markets include the United Kingdom, Germany, Australia, Canada, France, Italy, Spain, China, and Japan, with significant cross-border trade activity.
categories.supply_chain_position: eBay functions as a third-party, two-sided marketplace, acting as an intermediary that connects buyers and sellers but does not take ownership of inventory. It operates downstream in the supply chain, facilitating transactions, payments, shipping, and value-added services such as authentication and advertising.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: eBay's strategic priorities include enhancing the marketplace experience through technology, expanding category-specific experiences for enthusiasts, growing first-party advertising, and strengthening trust and safety. The company is investing heavily in AI and generative AI to drive personalization, discovery, and operational efficiency, while also focusing on payments innovation and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: eBay generates revenue primarily through transaction fees (take rate) on completed sales, which include commissions, payment processing, and listing fees. Additional revenue streams include first-party advertising fees (Promoted Listings and related products), store subscription fees, and shipping services. The majority of revenue is tied to the value of goods sold on its platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: eBay faces intense competition from global and local online marketplaces (notably Amazon and Alibaba), specialized category sites, traditional retailers, social commerce platforms (e.g., Facebook Marketplace, Instagram, TikTok), and multi-channel services like Shopify. While eBay is a leading global marketplace, it competes on price, selection, trust, and user experience, and is increasingly focused on enthusiast and recommerce categories to differentiate from larger, generalist competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, eBay enabled $75 billion in GMV and generated $10.3 billion in net revenues, with 134 million active buyers and 2.3 billion live listings globally. Revenue grew 2% year-over-year, with operating margins of 22.5%. The company maintains strong cash flow, significant share repurchases, and a stable dividend, but faces modest growth amid competitive and macroeconomic pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: eBay emphasizes unique selection, global reach, and value, enabling access to both new and pre-owned goods, including hard-to-find and enthusiast items. Its platform offers low barriers to entry for sellers, robust buyer protection (Money Back Guarantee), authentication for luxury and collectibles, and AI-driven tools for discovery and selling. eBay positions itself as a trusted, inclusive marketplace that empowers economic opportunity and sustainable commerce.
